description: Content approval step halted — read.py unable to reach Slack API. Both read.py and post.py failed with '403 Tunnel connection failed' error when attempting to read thread replies from #content. Network access or bot token validation failed in sandbox environment.
correction: Content approval cannot proceed without Slack connectivity. Manual verification required: (1) Verify SLACK_BOT_TOKEN in config/.env is current and valid, (2) Check sandbox network policy allows outbound HTTPS to Slack API, (3) Retry approval check in interactive session if sandbox restrictions prevent bot access.
systemic_fix: Route Slack read operations to interactive session or confirm sandbox network access to Slack API endpoints; consider fallback to manual approval polling via web interface if bot access remains blocked.
